pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #15 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When should you swim? (1 mark)
   A. Only when a teacher or lifeguard is watching
   B. In the dark
   C. Alone
   D. Whenever you like

2. What helps your body to float? (1 mark)
   A. Kicking hard only
   B. Holding a stone
   C. Water pushes up on it and lungs full of air
   D. Being heavy

3. A streamlined shape is (1 mark)
   A. bent like a chair
   B. round like a ball
   C. wide and floppy
   D. long and thin like an arrow

4. Which is a safe way to enter the pool? (1 mark)
   A. Head first from a run
   B. Feet first, watched by the teacher
   C. Jumping onto others
   D. Being pushed

5. Which is part of pool hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Eating in the pool
   B. Not passing urine or spitting in the pool
   C. Not showering
   D. Wearing dirty clothes

6. If you are in trouble in the water, you should (1 mark)
   A. raise your arm and shout for help
   B. swim into the deep end
   C. hide underwater
   D. stay quiet

7. In the sit-and-slide entry, you first (1 mark)
   A. jump
   B. sit on the edge with feet in the water
   C. dive
   D. run

8. The crab walk strengthens the (1 mark)
   A. hair
   B. eyes
   C. arms, shoulders and tummy
   D. ears

9. In the frog jump, you should land (1 mark)
   A. on your head
   B. stiff
   C. softly with bent knees
   D. on your back

10. In the giraffe stretch, you (1 mark)
   A. swim
   B. stand tall on toes with arms high
   C. crawl
   D. roll

11. Before animal games you should (1 mark)
   A. sleep
   B. eat a big meal
   C. fight
   D. warm up

12. Which Kiswahili word means snake? (1 mark)
   A. nyoka
   B. tumbili
   C. chura
   D. kuku

13. Animal games are inspired by (1 mark)
   A. the movements and behaviour of animals
   B. clouds
   C. tall buildings
   D. cars

14. Which is a focus when analysing a team sport performance? (1 mark)
   A. Teamwork and safety
   B. The colour of shoes only
   C. The price of the ball
   D. The weather only

15. Which value is found in the Kenya National Anthem? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Unity
   C. Cheating
   D. Selfishness

16. Which of these is a national day on which the anthem is sung? (1 mark)
   A. Sports day only
   B. Jamhuri Day
   C. Birthday of a friend
   D. Market day

17. Good feedback should be (1 mark)
   A. only praise with no reasons
   B. only criticism
   C. kind, honest, specific and helpful
   D. rude and short

18. A portfolio is (1 mark)
   A. a ball
   B. a folder for keeping creative works together
   C. a kind of paint
   D. a song

19. Which are instrumentalists in a folk song? (1 mark)
   A. The umpire
   B. The audience
   C. Dancers only
   D. People playing drums or shakers

20. Works on display should be kept away from (1 mark)
   A. water, direct sun and dust
   B. shelves
   C. other pictures
   D. walls

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. State three occasions when the Kenya National Anthem is sung. (3 marks)

22. Name three water games and say how one is played. (3 marks)

23. List the components of a folk song that you can analyse. (4 marks)

24. Explain why it is dangerous for a child to jump into a river to rescue someone. (3 marks)

25. Explain why animal games are called indigenous activities. (3 marks)

26. Describe how to play an animal game safely and fairly from warm-up to the end. (5 marks)

27. State four safety rules for the swimming pool. (4 marks)

28. State three mistakes in gliding and how to correct them. (3 marks)

29. How can an elder help you to learn indigenous games? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #15 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Only when a teacher or lifeguard is watching
   Supervision keeps swimmers safe.

2. C — Water pushes up on it and lungs full of air
   Buoyancy and air in the lungs.

3. D — long and thin like an arrow
   A long shape slips easily through water.

4. B — Feet first, watched by the teacher
   Feet-first entry is safe.

5. B — Not passing urine or spitting in the pool
   Keeping the pool clean matters.

6. A — raise your arm and shout for help
   Signal for help.

7. B — sit on the edge with feet in the water
   You sit, turn and slide in.

8. C — arms, shoulders and tummy
   The body is held up by the arms and legs.

9. C — softly with bent knees
   Bent knees absorb the shock.

10. B — stand tall on toes with arms high
   Reach up like a giraffe.

11. D — warm up
   Warming up prepares muscles.

12. A — nyoka
   Nyoka is a snake.

13. A — the movements and behaviour of animals
   Children copy how animals move.

14. A — Teamwork and safety
   Teamwork and safety matter.

15. B — Unity
   The anthem speaks of unity, peace, justice and service.

16. B — Jamhuri Day
   Jamhuri Day is a national holiday.

17. C — kind, honest, specific and helpful
   Good feedback helps the person improve.

18. B — a folder for keeping creative works together
   It protects and presents works.

19. D — People playing drums or shakers
   Instrumentalists play instruments.

20. A — water, direct sun and dust
   Water, sun and dust can damage works.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: School assembly, Madaraka Day, Mashujaa Day, Jamhuri Day, sports events and other official ceremonies. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Bubble blowing, treasure hunt, follow the leader, water tag, circle walk. One correct explanation.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three games, or 1 mark each for two games and an explanation.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: Community of origin, type or occasion, message, participants and their roles, and instruments.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four correct components.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: The child may also drown because water can be deep or fast. It is safer to shout for an adult and throw something that floats.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the danger, 2 marks for the safe action.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: They come from the communities and their environment, need little or no equipment and are learnt by watching and joining in.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

26. (5 marks)
   Answer: Warm up and choose soft clear ground. Explain the rules and roles. Play the game without pushing or pulling. Stop at the whistle and give everyone a turn. Cool down and drink water.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each stage.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Swim only when watched; never swim alone; walk on the pool side; no pushing; no diving in shallow water; follow the whistle. Any four.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Lifting the head: keep it between the arms; bent arms or legs: stretch them; pushing too hard: push gently. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: The elder can teach you the games and songs of the community and share their stories.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
